== Published English Original Virtual Set 7 wording ==
The Used mode removes the named Objective prerequisite and responds to peeking. It specifies the same deck or pile, with a choice of one of the top three. The Lost mode still adds 5 battle destiny but replaces taking the bottom Lost Pile card into hand with optional retrieval of 1 Force.
